title: mq-hal intent
description: Structured intent produced by the Ollama model and validated by the safe Python router before any command is executed.

schema.description: Intent schema version. Must always be mq-hal.intent.v1.

intent.description: The routed action. Any value not in this enum is mapped to refuse by the router before execution.

repo.description: Target repo key from config/repos.json, or null to use the active repo from state.

command.description: Subcommand for run_mqlaunch. Must be an allowed mqlaunch command. Null for all other intents.

args.description: Arguments passed to the routed command. For grep_repo: the search query. For create_branch: the branch name. For open_editor: the file path.

message.description: Human-readable description of the resolved action. Use the same language as the user prompt.

risk_level.description: Risk classification for this intent. Optional.

rollback_plan.description: How to undo this action if needed. Optional.

requires_confirmation.description: Whether this intent requires explicit user confirmation beyond the default. Optional.
